visualCharacteristics: Our Products: lines of business, each with a head (icon, title link, description) and a grid of linked product cards with icon and label.
contentPattern: Section heading as default content before the block. One row per line of business: cell 1 = icon image, title paragraph (a link; plain text = full-width "other" line), optional description; cell 2 = per product an icon image followed by a paragraph with the product link. A "(…)" suffix is desktop-only label text.
usage: Use for the grouped product catalogue on landing pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for grouped link grids by category; use cards for a single flat grid.
